page.name: Lighting
page.label: "Relight a connected Source with the Normal input. Source is optional; without it, the FX shades a white surface so the normal map can be inspected on its own."

page.name: Normal Input
page.label: "The Normal port accepts any raster source. Use Unsigned RGB for PNG/TIFF normal maps and Signed XYZ for float OpenEXR normal passes. Normal pixels are treated as raw data, not color."
"Normals use camera/view space: +X points right, +Y points up, and +Z points toward the viewer. Use the flip controls to match the exporter or normal-map convention."

page.name: Output
page.label: "Relit Source preserves Source alpha and shades white when Source is disconnected. Lighting Only shows the computed illumination; Normal Preview shows the decoded normal directions."
